description: Schedule 1 application for an application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a Non Material Amendment in connection with the planning permission (DC/25/139601) dated 10 April 2025, for the variation of Condition (2) in order to allow:-  Remove and replace existing uPVC white lap cladding with new as a part of a venti lated external wall insulation system with fire barriers; Remove and replace existing windows with white uPVC to match with higher performing models; Remove and replace all existing external doors with white uPVC doors featuring glazed screens including main entrance and maintenance balcony doors; Spot repair and paint rendered plinth/ lower walls sections around all blocks. Colour to be off-white to match existing coat; Replace existing flat roof membrane with higher performing robust flat roof system. Colour to match existing. Fascias and ancillary components to be white as existing at blocks at Johnstone House, Belmont Hill SE13.
site_name: JOHNSTONE HOUSE, BELMONT HILL, LONDON, SE13 5BB
